definitions.gloss: detached house; standalone house; single-family home
definitions.explanation: A house that stands on its own, not connected to other buildings — as opposed to an apartment or row house. Also can refer to a solitary house standing alone in an isolated location. Composed of 一 (one) + 軒 (house counter) + 家 (house).

examples.japanese: {一軒家|いっけんや}に{住|す}みたい。
examples.english: I want to live in a detached house.

examples.japanese: マンションより{一軒家|いっけんや}のほうが{庭|にわ}が{持|も}てる。
examples.english: With a detached house you can have a garden, unlike an apartment.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{中|なか}にぽつんと{一軒家|いっけんや}が{建|た}っていた。
examples.english: A solitary house stood alone in the mountains.

notes:
USAGE:
{一軒家|いっけんや} is commonly used when discussing housing choices — detached house vs. apartment (マンション). In real estate, it is a standard category.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一軒家|いっけんや}を{建|た}てる (to build a detached house)
- {一軒家|いっけんや}に{住|す}む (to live in a detached house)
- {中古|ちゅうこ}{一軒家|いっけんや} (secondhand detached house)
- ぽつんと{一軒家|いっけんや} (a solitary house — also the title of a popular TV show)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The TV show 「ポツンと{一軒家|いっけんや}」 features visits to isolated houses in remote mountain locations across Japan, and has popularized the image of a lone house in the wilderness.
